_note: Index of three funded escrow-upto payments on Eden mainnet (chain 714) through the Houston payment server, recorded on the client side. Inputs of edenescrow-gen; never edited by hand. No key, credential or token is recorded. The deposits are settled and their paymentIds used, so nothing here can be replayed.

provenance.wire: The bytes as they went over the wire: an HTTP header value as the HTTP library returned it (no trailing newline), or the signed transaction as sent (0x and lower-case hex, no trailing newline).
provenance.reconstructed: A JSON body re-serialized from the parsed answer or request: compact, member order kept, one LF at the end (Go encoding/json Encoder style). Every value is the one received or sent; the bytes are probably, not provably, the wire bytes. Where the answer was not compressed, content_length is the server's Content-Length and the file has exactly that length.
provenance.rpc: An Eden JSON-RPC result as parsed, pretty-printed: values verbatim, layout ours.
provenance.observed: A value read from an answer (status, header, a member of a parsed body) or from Eden RPC after the run, written in this index by hand.

runs.summary: Payment-Signature over the 32 raw bytes of paymentId; deposit sent through POST /v1/deposit/send; paid retry 200; settled by the facilitator.

files.what: payment-required header of the 402 quote
body of the 402 quote (not the requirements)
answer of POST /v1/deposit/build (sent gzip-compressed, so its length cannot be compared)
the signed deposit transaction as sent
the client's POST /v1/deposit/send request body
answer of POST /v1/deposit/send (header deprecation: true)
answer of GET /v1/deposit/status/<txHash>
payment-signature header of the paid retry
payment-response header of the paid retry's 200

runs.summary: Payment-Signature over the 32 raw bytes of extra.nonce instead of paymentId; deposit sent through POST /v1/deposit/send; paid retry 403. A Payment-Signature over paymentId for the same deposit, made by hand later, got 200 (its header value was not recorded); the deposit was settled.

files.what: payment-required header of the 402 quote
the signed deposit transaction as sent
payment-signature header of the paid retry, signed over extra.nonce
body of the paid retry's 403
payment-response header of the 200 to the later retry signed over paymentId

runs.summary: Deposit sent only with eth_sendRawTransaction to an Eden RPC; POST /v1/deposit/send never called. Payment-Signature over paymentId; paid retry 200 on the first try; settled by the facilitator.
